name: Task Status Summary
description: Overview of all task transactions by status with counts and percentages
query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*)*100.0/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_transaction), 2) as percentage FROM task_transaction GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

name: Overdue Tasks Analysis
description: Tasks that are past scheduled date and not yet completed
query: SELECT id, task_id, task_description_id, priority, scheduled_date, assigned_user_id, facility_id, DATEDIFF(NOW(), scheduled_date) as days_overdue FROM task_transaction WHERE scheduled_date < NOW() AND status < 2 ORDER BY priority DESC, days_overdue DESC

name: Facility Workload Analysis
description: Number of open tasks by facility with completion rate
joins: LEFT JOIN facility ON task_transaction.facility_id = facility.id
query: SELECT facility.id, facility.name, COUNT(*) as total_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN task_transaction.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN task_transaction.status < 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as open_tasks, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN task_transaction.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*), 2) as completion_rate FROM task_transaction LEFT JOIN facility ON task_transaction.facility_id = facility.id GROUP BY facility.id, facility.name ORDER BY open_tasks DESC

name: User Task Assignment Summary
description: Task distribution and completion metrics by assigned user
joins: LEFT JOIN user ON task_transaction.assigned_user_id = user.id
query: SELECT user.id, user.first_name, user.last_name, COUNT(*) as total_assigned, SUM(CASE WHEN task_transaction.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed, SUM(CASE WHEN task_transaction.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as in_progress, SUM(CASE WHEN task_transaction.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending, SUM(CASE WHEN task_transaction.scheduled_date < NOW() AND task_transaction.status < 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as overdue FROM task_transaction LEFT JOIN user ON task_transaction.assigned_user_id = user.id GROUP BY user.id, user.first_name, user.last_name ORDER BY overdue DESC, in_progress DESC

name: Priority Breakdown Report
description: Task distribution across priority levels with status breakdown
query: SELECT priority, COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as in_progress, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as overdue FROM task_transaction GROUP BY priority ORDER BY priority DESC

name: Completion Rate Trend
description: Daily task completion metrics over time
query: SELECT DATE(closed_time) as completion_date, COUNT(*) as tasks_completed, AVG(DATEDIFF(closed_time, scheduled_date)) as avg_days_to_complete FROM task_transaction WHERE status = 2 AND closed_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE(closed_time) ORDER BY completion_date DESC LIMIT 30

name: Asset Maintenance History
description: Maintenance tasks performed on each asset
joins: LEFT JOIN asset ON task_transaction.asset_id = asset.id
query: SELECT asset.id, asset.name, asset.code, COUNT(*) as total_maintenance_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN task_transaction.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed_maintenance, MAX(task_transaction.closed_time) as last_maintenance_date FROM task_transaction LEFT JOIN asset ON task_transaction.asset_id = asset.id WHERE task_transaction.asset_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY asset.id, asset.name, asset.code ORDER BY total_maintenance_tasks DESC

name: Checklist Compliance Tracking
description: Compliance checklist status and completion metrics
query: SELECT check_list_transaction.status, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(CASE WHEN check_list_transaction.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed FROM check_list_transaction LEFT JOIN task_transaction ON check_list_transaction.task_transaction_id = task_transaction.id GROUP BY check_list_transaction.status ORDER BY check_list_transaction.status

name: Schedule Performance Report
description: Performance metrics for recurring maintenance schedules
joins: LEFT JOIN facility ON scheduler.facility_id = facility.id
LEFT JOIN scheduler_task ON scheduler.id = scheduler_task.scheduler_id
query: SELECT scheduler.id, scheduler.name, facility.name as facility_name, COUNT(scheduler_task.id) as generated_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN scheduler_task.is_open = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as open_schedules FROM scheduler LEFT JOIN facility ON scheduler.facility_id = facility.id LEFT JOIN scheduler_task ON scheduler.id = scheduler_task.scheduler_id GROUP BY scheduler.id, scheduler.name, facility.name ORDER BY open_schedules DESC

name: SLA Breach Alert Report
description: Critical tasks approaching or exceeding SLA limits
joins: LEFT JOIN user ON task_transaction.assigned_user_id = user.id
LEFT JOIN facility ON task_transaction.facility_id = facility.id
query: SELECT task_transaction.id, task_transaction.task_id, task_transaction.priority, task_transaction.scheduled_date, DATEDIFF(NOW(), task_transaction.scheduled_date) as days_overdue, user.first_name, user.last_name, facility.name as facility_name FROM task_transaction LEFT JOIN user ON task_transaction.assigned_user_id = user.id LEFT JOIN facility ON task_transaction.facility_id = facility.id WHERE task_transaction.status < 2 AND task_transaction.scheduled_date < DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY task_transaction.priority DESC, days_overdue DESC
